contract_change: Keep DG-015 and its failed fixture unchanged. New version appends a separately C-tokenized exact-byte suffix to the actual immutable token prefix; the concatenation need not equal canonical whole-string BPE. No prefix rewriting or Python tokenizer approximation.
method: Use <|im_end|> ONLY as a tokenizer boundary anchor. Encode anchor and anchor+value with the bound C tokenizer, require unchanged anchor token prefix, remove that exact prefix, and require suffix byte equality. Anchor is never passed to backbone or emitted. Reject all special/control tokens in suffix. Validate actual prefix by its decoded bytes, not re-encoding canonicality.
fixtures: All 11 DG-015 inputs unchanged. Under this NEW contract prefix-space-merge and prefix-letter-merge must now succeed; control-marker and over-budget must still reject. Add three fixtures below. Preserve original DG-015 expected labels/report separately.
native_forward_gate: For every accepted fixture, before each forced value token and at value completion, run fresh ordinary C reference and zero-increment continuous probe on the exact actual prefix. Require bitwise equal hidden/logits, finite values, fresh-context trace and unchanged prefix bytes. At completion return base argmax; do not claim it is a correct natural continuation. No cross-step KV reuse; internal one-prefill K/V work buffers remain.
semantic_limits: Artificial span choice, not neural activation, not full reply generation or recall accuracy. Different valid segmentations may produce different hidden/logits; do not assert canonical/noncanonical numerical equivalence. No source episode or tokenizer anchor in decoder prefix.
stop: No training, seed search, new model, deployment, LoCoMo, prefix rewriting, whitespace stripping, partial-value fallback or changing old evaluation labels. Retain failures and raw C evidence.
